description: Classify listing pages vs articles; gate on one literal verdict; date metrics over articles only.
name: Scout Fetch

description: Insights are now REPLACED per run instead of accumulating; diagnostics over articles only.
name: Scout Health

description: Index the OWNER'S own published articles from their sitemap (urls + lastmod only, never page bodies). Writes solely to p-scout-owned, so owner content can never enter the findings corpus, and scout-taxonomy can subtract what is already covered.
name: Scout Owned Inventory

description: Widen the crawl via a search API (brave|tavily|serper, whichever key is present). Emits frontierCandidates at depth 0, deduped against the registry and filtered by the brief's denyHosts. Key via $SEARCH_API_KEY, never in a token.
name: Scout Search

description: Deterministic rollup: per-category counts with recency split, per-competitor coverage, chrome-stripped full text of fresh findings from their blobs, AND a join against p-scout-owned yielding ownCovered/ownUncovered per category plus a trueGaps list.
name: Scout Taxonomy

description: Assemble ONE writing packet for the drafting persona: oldest accepted article task without a draft, the competitor article's stored text (blob or URL-fallback, chrome-stripped), related own slugs by term overlap, and the brief. The task token is never consumed — dedupe is by the drafts+queue ledger, so cron and on-demand triggers are both safe.
name: Scout Write Prep
